cards.title: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores
cards.headline: Mensah-Cole's Goal Breaks Deadlock
cards.story: At 26 minutes, Yaw Mensah-Cole scored from close range (7.1m) with a powerful 97.3 km/h shot, giving Ashvale Rovers a 1-0 lead. This goal came after a 22-second buildup with 4 passes, reflecting Ashvale's dominance (58.6% possession) and high xG (0.68). The chaotic tempo (pulse_chaos 1.35) underlines the intense match pace.

cards.title: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores
cards.headline: Yaw Mensah-Cole Doubles Lead for Ashvale
cards.story: At 29 minutes, Yaw Mensah-Cole scored his second goal for Ashvale Rovers, extending their lead to 2-0 over Kestrel Bay FC. This goal came after a quick 6.7-second buildup with only two passes, reflecting Ashvale's dominance with 56.5% possession and 8 shots. The scoreline now puts Ashvale in a commanding position early in the match.

cards.title: Adebayo Lorne scores
cards.headline: Kestrel Bay narrows gap with Lorne's strike
cards.story: At 40 minutes, Adebayo Lorne scores from 8.3 meters, assisted by Kai Holmberg, cutting Ashvale Rovers' lead to 2-1. Despite Kestrel Bay's lower possession (46.2%) and fewer shots (2), this goal shifts momentum in a chaotic match with pulse dominance still favoring Ashvale (0.45). It sets up a tense finish.

cards.title: Kestrel Bay FC switch to 4-2-3-1
cards.headline: Kestrel Bay FC shifts to 4-2-3-1 formation
cards.story: At 66 minutes, Kestrel Bay FC changed from a 4-3-3 to a 4-2-3-1 formation while trailing 2-1. Despite Ashvale Rovers holding 51.3% possession and 14 shots to Kestrel Bay's 4, the pulse dominance of 0.368 indicates Kestrel Bay is gaining control. This tactical shift signals Kestrel Bay's intent to influence the game's momentum.

claims.text: Kestrel Bay FC switched formation from 4-3-3 to 4-2-3-1 at 66 minutes
Ashvale Rovers lead 2-1 with higher possession (51.3%) and more shots (14)
Pulse dominance of 0.368 shows Kestrel Bay FC gaining control despite trailing
Match tempo is controlled but slightly slower than normal with pulse chaos at 0.75

en.caption: Kestrel Bay FC shifts from 4-3-3 to 4-2-3-1 at 66', gaining pulse dominance 0.368 despite trailing 2-1.

fr.caption: Kestrel Bay FC passe de 4-3-3 à 4-2-3-1 à la 66e, dominance d'impulsion 0,368 malgré un score de 1-2.

ar.caption: كسترل باي يغير من 4-3-3 إلى 4-2-3-1 عند الدقيقة 66 مع سيطرة نبض 0.368 رغم تأخره 2-1.

en.caption: At 66 minutes, Kestrel Bay changed shape to try to take control, though Ashvale leads 2-1 with more ball and shots.

fr.caption: À la 66e, Kestrel Bay change de formation pour reprendre le contrôle, mais Ashvale mène 2-1 avec plus de possession.

ar.caption: عند الدقيقة 66، كسترل باي غيّر تشكيلته لمحاولة السيطرة رغم تقدم آشڤيل 2-1 مع استحواذ أكثر.

issues: Claim that Ashvale Rovers have higher possession is incorrect; facts show Ashvale Rovers have 51.3% possession and Kestrel Bay FC 48.7%, so Ashvale Rovers do have higher possession, but the claim also states Ashvale Rovers have more shots, which is correct. However, the story says Ashvale Rovers hold a slight possession edge but fewer shots, which contradicts the facts showing Ashvale Rovers have more shots (14 vs 4).

The story states the formation change aims to stabilize midfield and create more attacking options, which is an interpretation not directly supported by facts and should be framed more cautiously or omitted.

The claim about match pulse showing controlled tempo with home team dominance is partially misleading; pulse_dominance is 0.368, which suggests the away team (Kestrel Bay FC) is dominant, not the home team.

cards.title: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores
cards.headline: Mensah-Cole seals Ashvale's late lead
cards.story: At 89', Yaw Mensah-Cole scored his third goal, assisted by Elias Brandt, to put Ashvale Rovers ahead 3-2 against Kestrel Bay FC. Despite Kestrel Bay's recent pressure and a near-equal possession (home_possession_pct 50.3 vs away_possession_pct 49.7), Ashvale's clinical finishing (home_shots 17 vs away_shots 7) made the difference. This goal likely secures Ashvale's advantage in the final minutes.

claims.text: Mensah-Cole scored a crucial third goal at 89 minutes
Ashvale Rovers maintained a slight possession edge of 50.3%
Ashvale took more than double the shots of Kestrel Bay FC (17 vs 7)
The goal came after a quick 10.7 second buildup with only 1 pass
